title: Just been getting starting on building out the 2nd level in my game Cave Drop, how do you think its looking so far?
author: dank_summers
selftext: Been having a ton of fun starting out on the 2nd zone after i was debugging the first zone for so long and rekindled my interest. But I think i just have now realized how big of a scope my project really is what I have gotten myself into haha

comments.author: Raging_Rob
comments.body: I'll be honest I think it looks really messy and I can't quite tell what I'm even looking at. I do like the the color palette though

comments.author: Raging_Rob
comments.body: i think it's the large amount of trees all over the ground and walls. feels a bit too much for me, especially since they all look like more or less the same asset with differences in color

replies.author: dank_summers
replies.body:
Hmm interesting, I actually have 15 tree models in here and they all have different color versions. Once your in the zone it's obvious, but I'm really trying to nail this money shot. 

The wall and ceiling being playable areas is the games hook though so may just not be for you
